item.title: 87% of the Anthropic power will come from gas and 11% from coal in 2028
item.description: A case study of Anthropic's total power use and emissions. We find the company could emit 32 million metric tons of carbon dioxide in 2028. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: LLM agents work for their parent companies, not for you
item.description: I built an Instagram-to-Bandcamp tool with Claude, but when the API broke, the model refused to help me work around it, while happily downloading from YouTube instead, which pays the artist nothing. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: Tidal bans AI-generated music
item.description: The music streaming service Tidal said Tuesday that it would ban tracks it believes are completely AI-generated starting next month, (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: A Beginner's Guide to Local AI with Inkling, Qwen, and Unsloth
item.description: We have AI at home! Set up your own free personal ChatGPT on your PC with Unsloth and Inkling or Qwen. It's private, and the whole house can use it. (1 source: hackernews)
